rca_of_issue.bug: coach/[id].tsx crashed with 'TouchableOpacity is not defined' and 'Ionicons is not defined'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: When E1 added the service card clickability feature (lines 89-111) to coach/[id].tsx, they used TouchableOpacity and Ionicons but did not add the corresponding imports. TouchableOpacity was missing from react-native import, Ionicons was not imported at all.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Navigate to /coach/{any_coach_id}. 2. React renders CoachProfileScreen. 3. Line 91: <TouchableOpacity ... throws ReferenceError because TouchableOpacity is not in scope.
rca_of_issue.fix: Added TouchableOpacity to react-native import destructure and added 'import { Ionicons } from @expo/vector-icons'
rca_of_issue.prevention: Run TypeScript strict mode - would have caught undefined references. Also: always add imports when copy-pasting JSX with new component references.
